scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes all-real-parameter inequalities. Exact rational calculations cover 16 selected conductance profiles and do not constitute exhaustive testing or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Connected four-direction translation-invariant nonnegative conductance networks on F_3^2 only; no claim for other Cayley groups or noninvariant weights. The most directly relevant 2011 Cayley-resistance article was not available in full text; equivalent coverage remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp resistance negative type on the nine-vertex ternary Cayley torus
